description.p: Arbor is a small mind map editor with XMind's key bindings, so you can grow a map as fast as you can type: Tab adds a subtopic, Enter adds a sibling, and the arrow keys move around the tree.
Drag topics to rearrange them, select several at once, collapse branches, paste plain-text outlines as topics, and undo any change. Maps are saved as plain JSON .mind files.
